batch: 6 (chs 33-37, the watchman, the shepherds, the new heart, the dry bones)

units.characteristics: the watchman re-commissioned; despair answered by God's no-pleasure in death; turn and live
units.gist: THE GEM - the WATCHMAN re-commissioned ('if you do not warn... his blood I will require; if you warn... you will have DELIVERED YOUR SOUL'); the despairing 'our transgressions are upon us, and we ROT AWAY; HOW THEN CAN WE LIVE?'; answered - 'I have NO PLEASURE IN THE DEATH OF THE WICKED, but that the wicked TURN from his way and LIVE; TURN BACK, turn back... WHY WILL YOU DIE?'; the future open both ways (the righteous who trusts his righteousness / the wicked who turns)

units.characteristics: the self-feeding shepherds vs the true Shepherd who himself seeks the lost
units.gist: GEM - 'woe to the shepherds who have been FEEDING THEMSELVES! you eat the fat, clothe yourselves with the wool, but you do not FEED THE SHEEP. The WEAK you have not strengthened, the SICK not healed, the INJURED not bound up, the STRAYED not brought back, the LOST not sought'; against them - 'I, I MYSELF will SEARCH for my sheep and seek them out... I will bind up the injured, strengthen the weak'; 'one shepherd, my servant David'; a COVENANT OF PEACE; and Edom's gloating enmity judged (35)

units.characteristics: cleansing and the new heart/new spirit, for God's name's sake; the shame grace produces
units.gist: THE PEAK GEM - 'it is NOT FOR YOUR SAKE... but for the sake of MY HOLY NAME that I am about to act'; 'I will SPRINKLE CLEAN WATER on you, and you shall be CLEAN from all your uncleannesses'; 'I will give you a NEW HEART, and a NEW SPIRIT I will put within you. I will remove the HEART OF STONE and give you a HEART OF FLESH. And I will put MY SPIRIT within you, and CAUSE YOU TO WALK in my statutes'; 'BE ASHAMED and confounded for your ways' (grace producing shame)

units.characteristics: the resurrection of the hopeless, dead interior by God's Spirit; the joined nation; the everlasting covenant
units.gist: THE GEM - the valley of DRY BONES: 'can these bones live? O Lord GOD, YOU KNOW'; the despairing 'our bones are DRIED UP, and our HOPE IS LOST; we are indeed CUT OFF'; 'I will OPEN YOUR GRAVES and raise you... I will put MY SPIRIT WITHIN YOU, and you shall LIVE'; breath from the four winds making an exceedingly great army; the two sticks joined (one nation), 'one shepherd David', 'a COVENANT OF PEACE... my SANCTUARY in their midst forevermore'
